name: Honjouji Akira
source: Akira, Anne Mitter's charismatic red-headed waitress, is the heroine of the Rise series. Strong-willed, compassionate and an expert of martial arts - third grade mastery in judo and fourth grade mastery in both karate and aikido - Akira doesn't take well to insincerity, injustice, or imprisonment.
